extraction.Name: Angeline Larvie Roberta
extraction.Recorded patent: patent recorded by P. J. Navin on June 24, 1920
extraction.Buyer: Mortgage by Angeline Roberts and James Roberts and Ray L. Briggs for $2600; Mortgage executed in favor of Jordan State Bank June 17, 1920 for $1000; Deed by Angeline and James Roberts dated March 6, 1923, conveyed the land to Ray L. and Margaret Briggs for $1600, subject to the mortgage which purchaser assumes and agrees to pay
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739659 issued; Southeast quarter section 9, township 40, north of range 33; receipt for patent signed by allottee April 5, 1920; Contract for deed dated August 25, 1920 between Angeline Larvie Roberts and James Roberts on deferred payments plan to be completed by November 1, 1921; Briggs assumes the mortgage for $1000
